items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Cab Calloway in the context of Red Calendar having 'played with Cab Calloway' and narrates an altercation between Cab Calloway and Dizzy Gillespie, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself (John Simmons) and Cab Calloway.

ctx.x: When a band would come to town, a traveling band, and play, say, Thursday nights in the Negro section, would that band maybe play Saturday night in the white section for a white audience?

Sometimes. There was a dance hall there called the Skyline. That was a public dance. Now, when Duke and Cab came to town, Duke would generally play the convention hall, and Cab would be at some arena where they held hockey games, you know. It was an arena, like.
Did everybody go, or was it restricted?
